items.title: Western Digital Earnings Beat With 44% Sales Growth. But Stock Tumbles Late.
items.summary: Western Digital stock slid late Wednesday despite the hard-disk drive maker reporting fiscal fourth-quarter results ahead of estimates.  Western Digital, which recently rebranded as WD, said its adjusted earnings climbed 109% to $3.56 per share for the June quarter.  WD and its rival Seagate Technology dominate the hard-disk drive market.
